note: State + federal data center water/energy disclosure legislation. 'verified: true' means the status was confirmed this session against a primary/authoritative source; 'verified: false' entries are from secondary reporting and should be re-checked against the legislature record before being relied upon.

bills.title: Data center water reporting
bills.summary: Water utilities must report the monthly volume of water delivered to data centers, including reclaimed water.
bills.status_detail: Signed by Gov. Spanberger (2026); amends Va. Code 62.1-44.38; effective ~July 1, 2026.

bills.title: Data center environmental, energy, and water requirements
bills.summary: Water-appropriation permit process and DNR preapplication review for data centers expected to use >100M gal/yr; evaluates water source and conservation.
bills.status_detail: Signed by Gov. Walz June 14, 2025 (Laws 2025, 1st Spec. Sess., Ch. 12); amends Minn. Stat. 103G.271 / 103G.265.

bills.title: Data center water-use disclosure
bills.summary: Would have required annual water-use disclosure by data centers.

bills.title: Data Center Transparency Act
bills.summary: Would bar local governments from using NDAs to hide data center water/energy use.

bills.title: Responsible Water Use
bills.status_detail: In committee; Ohio formed a Joint Data Center Committee (May 2026).

bills.title: Data center water-consumption reporting
bills.summary: Monthly/annual water-consumption reports to the Division of Water Resources.

bills.title: Data center closed-loop cooling
bills.summary: Would mandate closed-loop cooling (zero net withdrawal) for data centers.

bills.title: Data center energy/water reporting
bills.summary: Monthly energy/water reporting to the State Energy Commission.

bills.title: Data center water reporting
bills.summary: Quarterly water-use reports for data centers.

bills.title: Data center water reporting
bills.summary: Annual water-use reports for data centers.

bills.title: Data center closed-loop cooling
bills.summary: Would require closed-loop cooling for data centers.

bills.title: Data Center Transparency Act
bills.summary: Directs EIA to collect data center energy data every 6 months; addresses air/water-quality effects.

bills.title: Liquid Cooling for AI Act of 2025
bills.summary: Water-efficiency-adjacent measure promoting liquid cooling for AI data centers.

bills.title: Durbin data center water & energy disclosure bill
bills.summary: Would direct states to aggregate/anonymize data center water + energy reports to EPA, DOE, and USDA.
bills.status_detail: Introduced ~Mar 2026; Senate bill number not confirmed.
